purpose: Run one bounded current-f01e TP1/PIECEWISE/native-MTP2/F16 exact-4K sentinel against two clean same-image TP1/MTP0 token parents, the TP1/MTP2 eager mechanism parent, and a cross-topology TP2/MTP1 graph precedent. This is a corruption-sensitive probe, not a matrix expansion or publication packet.

human_adjudication.scope: Only exact 4K is a clean measured PIECEWISE parent. Exact 8K is speedless and quarantined for same-image token-99 divergence. The original R3 validator lacked a cross-arm token-parity gate.

piecewise_mtp0_quality.gate: pass_all, baseline_match_all, 7/7 exact cases, 8/8 repeats with one hash, passing 8K needle, 24/24 baseline comparisons, and 16/16 cache-zero requests

mtp2_eager_mechanism_parent.role: Same-image TP1/MTP2/eager/F16 exact-4K mechanism and token-parity parent. Its whole six-depth arm is quarantined, so only the explicitly adjudicated clean 4K point transfers.

tp2_mtp1_graph_precedent.role: Cross-topology proof that current-f01e PIECEWISE plus native MTP1 can pass exact 4K. It supplies no TP1 token target, speed expectation, publication, or descendant authority.

historical_corruption_caveat.known_signature: The same current-f01e graph-family alternate appears as token hash dd31856f45269d222efe0f6f5f1ac9342b6c9ae55e5ce9129fc02b27abdb7e8e, with first divergence at generated token 99: graph token 411 versus eager target token 579.
historical_corruption_caveat.scope: Graph plus MTP has historical corruption evidence, and even MTP0 PIECEWISE is not clean at exact 8K in this parent campaign. This sentinel deliberately uses only clean exact 4K parents.
historical_corruption_caveat.mtp2_eager_depth_limits: The same-image TP1/MTP2 eager arm diverged from MTP0 at 2K token 90, 8K token 99, and 16K token 32. Only 4K transfers into this graph sentinel.
historical_corruption_caveat.forbidden_inference: A 4K pass does not clear 8K, long context, other MTP depths, TP2/TP4, other KV modes, or other runtime images. A mismatch is quarantined and does not erase prior evidence.

exact_depth_contract.candidate_gate: The candidate exact request must pass every depth-helper gate and report cached_tokens=0.
exact_depth_contract.dual_parent_gate: All 128 candidate token IDs must exactly equal both the eager MTP0 4K parent and the clean PIECEWISE MTP0 4K parent; the two parents must first equal each other.

quality_contract.gate: Candidate must independently satisfy pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven passing exact cases, eight passing identical repeats with one unique hash, a passing 8K needle, exactly 24 true baseline comparisons, and cached_tokens=0 on all 16 quality requests.

topology_and_graph_contract.topology: TP1 only: world_size=1 rank=0 local_rank=0 and TP rank 0 on ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0 / level_zero:0.
topology_and_graph_contract.selector: Container environment must contain ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0 and ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0. This TP1 composition is intentional; do not import the multi-GPU mask-only selector rule.
topology_and_graph_contract.graph: enforce_eager=False; PIECEWISE size-one capture; mixed prefill-decode PIECEWISE marker and Graph capturing finished required; FULL decode capture forbidden.
topology_and_graph_contract.speculation: Resolved native method mtp, target model path, and num_spec_tokens=2 required. Drafted and accepted counter deltas are isolated around the exact 4K request and must both be positive, with accepted <= drafted.
topology_and_graph_contract.cache: Fresh dedicated ext4 cache root, prefix cache disabled, exact and every quality request cache-zero.
topology_and_graph_contract.cleanup: One fresh container/server lifetime, global EXIT/INT/TERM cleanup, container absent, port closed, no EngineCore/vLLM/llama server, and no render users at sealing.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact 4K, isolated positive drafting/acceptance, dual-parent token equality, full objective and baseline quality, graph/topology identity, cache isolation, and cleanup all pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact 4K passes but isolated accepted speculation is not proven.
terminal_classification.quarantined-parent-parity-failed: Exact 4K passes but candidate tokens differ from either clean parent, or the pinned parents do not equal each other.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Exact 4K and mechanism/parity gates pass but the explicit full quality audit fails.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 4K request fails; retain only diagnostic evidence.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image log line explicitly classifying the native MTP/speculative method as unsupported.
terminal_classification.failed: Startup, identity, graph, topology, endpoint, model, cache isolation, cleanup, or other non-explicit failure.

interpretation.pass_authority: A pass establishes only this current-f01e TP1/PIECEWISE/native-MTP2/F16 exact-4K sentinel as internal evidence pending separate human adjudication.
